sidebar.accessDeniedTitle: You don't have access to Settings
sidebar.accessDeniedDescription: Ask an administrator to grant the required permission.

salesDirectory.title: Referral Code Integration
salesDirectory.subtitle: Sync your ambassador and sales team directory into CRM users. Each person's referral code is stored on their user, so assignment rules can route a lead to the person whose code it carries.

connection.title: Connection
connection.subtitle: The directory API the users are read from.
connection.baseUrlHint: The directory server address, for example https://directory.example.com.
connection.apiKeyStored: A key is stored (ends in {{hint}}). Leave blank to keep it.
connection.apiKeyWillClear: The stored key will be removed when you save.
connection.testOk: Connected: {{ambassadors}} ambassadors, {{sales}} sales, {{telesales}} telesales, {{remoteSales}} remote sales.

mapping.title: Team mapping
mapping.subtitle: Which CRM profile and org unit each directory team gets.
mapping.hint: Pick an existing profile and org unit for each team. They are used only when the sync creates a new user: anyone whose email already has a CRM user keeps their own profile and org unit.
mapping.createdOnSync: Not found — created on the first sync

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: The full directory is pulled once a day.
schedule.hint: The sync runs every day at this time in the selected time zone. Use Sync now to run it immediately.

runs.title: Sync runs
runs.subtitle: Scheduled, manual and webhook runs. Select a run to see each person's outcome.
runs.enableFirst: Add the base URL and API key and save before running it.

items.title: Sync run details
items.empty: No one was changed in this run.
items.emptyRunning: The run is still in progress — people appear here as they are processed.
items.running: This run is still in progress. The details refresh automatically.

messageValue.user_not_found: No CRM user matches this email or code
messageValue.duplicate_email: The same email appears more than once in the directory
messageValue.disabled_not_created: Disabled in the directory — not created
messageValue.create_users_off: Creating users is off for this team
messageValue.seat_limit: No seat left to create the user
messageValue.email_changed: Email changed in the directory (not applied)
messageValue.missing_pass_skipped: Suspensions skipped as a safety check: {{detail}}
messageValue.not_in_directory: Not listed in the directory yet
messageValue.directory_unavailable: The directory could not be reached

baseUrl.invalid: Enter a full URL starting with https://.

errors.load: Could not load the Referral Code Integration settings.
errors.mappingOptions: Could not load the profiles and org units.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.subtitle: Your agent system calls this endpoint to create, update or delete an agent and their referral code — no wait for the daily sync.
webhook.keyNone: No API key yet — the endpoint refuses every call until you generate one.
webhook.keyFailed: The API key could not be updated.
webhook.regenerateBody: The current key stops working immediately. The agent system must switch to the new key.
webhook.revokeBody: The endpoint refuses every call until a new key is generated.
webhook.notRevealable: This key was created before keys could be shown again. Regenerate it to view and copy it.
webhook.revealFailed: The API key could not be shown.
